thesis.description: One paragraph: the spatial idea. Must be a strategy, not a style label.

story.description: Why this room, this household, this idea. The narrative justification.

solves.description: Problem tags from the site survey, e.g. P1, P5

axes.description: The seven difference axes. Used to prove directions are genuinely distinct.

moves.description: The three to five headline interventions, in build order.

items.description: Every physical change, justified. This is the core of the deliverable.

validation.description: Why it survives this room's constraints: climate, proportion, circulation, damp, devotion, budget, use

removes.description: Existing items removed, and where they go

shrine.description: How the household's devotional niche is handled. Mandatory in this project.

heirlooms.description: How the curio contents are displayed

ventilation.description: How cross-ventilation and the fan are handled

not_for.description: Who this direction is wrong for

render.description: Scene descriptions per camera. Camera framing and room shell facts are added by build_prompts.py.

a.description: View A: standing in the main doorway looking down the length of the hall toward the far arch

b.description: View B: standing at the far arch looking back toward the main door and window

teak_treatment.description: How the inherited carved teak settee, armchairs and curio cabinet are re-worked and re-used IN THIS ROOM. Removing them is not permitted.

table.description: How the low table and the eating/study table function are provided. Deleting the table function is not permitted.

scale_check.description: Written proof the layout fits 3.12 m x 6.25 m: widths added across the narrow dimension, with the clear circulation lane stated.
